environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 service deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'reporting' on GKE cluster. The service is exposed via a ClusterIP service and accessible from any pod in the cluster. No Istio sidecar injection is configured for the namespace. The service listens on port 8080 and accepts requests from the internal gateway (namespace 'gateway') as well as any other namespace. Scriban 5.7.0 is used without MemberFilter restrictions.
